XDQ9uLf7qUKn.text: To solve this problem, you need to understand the physics principle related to the force experienced by a charged particle in a magnetic field

SNZGerZpkrEB.text: The force (F) on a charged particle moving in a magnetic field is given by the equation F = qvBsinθ, where q is the charge on the particle, v is its velocity, B is the magnetic field strength, and θ is the angle between the velocity of the particle and the magnetic field

duvz6HkYfbkL.text: In this problem, since there is no mention of the angle θ changing, you will focus on how changes in q, v, and potentially B (which is assumed constant here) affect F

zfNBv4j9sfRJ.text: The key entity to look up in Wikipedia for understanding this relationship would be the @Lorentz force@, which is the force exerted by electromagnetic fields on a charged particle
